c.v: can be configured as a SPI master by clearing the bit
In this operation mode, GP-SPI provides clock signal (the divided clock from GP-SPI module clock) and six CS lines (CS0 ~ CS5).
The length of transferred data must be in unit of bytes, otherwise the extra bits will be lost.
The extra bits here means the result of total data bits % 8.
To transfer bits not in unit of bytes, consider implementing it in CMD state or ADDR state.
